name: Heroine
source:
Our guy transferred to a new school. He is just in time to save the school theater club from being canceled. He gets to pick his heroine out of 3 girls for their next play. He also has to set schedule for set building, customs making, and practicing. Well, no matter, he still has time to chase the 5 club girls and 2 others.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公转入新学校，正好赶上拯救即将被取消的戏剧社。他要从三名少女中选出下一场戏的女主角，还得安排布景搭建、服装制作和排练日程。不过没关系，他仍有时间追求戏剧社的五名少女，以及另外两人。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
